description.narrative: The Overall Objective of this action is to support the forest sector¿s contribution to the EU and its partners¿ international commitments to climate and biodiversity and SDGs globally.The Specific(s) Objective(s) of this action are to:1.Test and pilot forest finance (FF) tools, including innovative and gender sensitive financing mechanisms in key partner countries2.Generate knowledge and develop capacity for the EU and its partners 3.Advocate and contribute to international debatesThe Outputs to be delivered by this action contributing to the corresponding Specific Objectives are: Test and pilot forest finance tools, including innovative and gender sensitive financing mechanisms in key partner countriesOutputs 11.1 Promising gender-sensitive forest finance (FF) interventions co-designed and piloted in up to 7 countries 1.2 Results of pilots assessed, documented, published and shared widely1.3 Forest Finance (FF) models & metrics proven to deliver on climate & biodiversity goals and possibly scaled-up or integrated into national systemsGenerate knowledge and develop capacity for the EU and its partners Outputs 22.1 Best practices & lessons learned on FF for climate & biodiversity generated and shared  2.2 Capacity building and knowledge on Forest finance solutions for climate & biodiversity delivered2.3. Advocacy promoted to share lessons learned & good practicesAdvocate and contribute to international debatesOutputs 33.1 High-level participation in international dialogues on role of Forest finance for climate & biodiversity promoted3.2  Strategic knowledge-sharing that aligns forest finance solutions including gender equality and women¿s empowerment with climate & biodiversity targets delivered3.3 Well-informed network of EU & partners championing forest finance for climate & biodiversity agenda created
